description: Answer 'give me the Teams app package for this agent': download the channel manifest zip (manifest.json plus icons) for an agent published to the Microsoft 365 and Teams channel, the same file the portal offers as 'Download .zip', for sideloading or the Teams admin centre. Writes only the zip file; nothing in the environment changes. The agent must already be published to that channel. Follows the published Power Platform API reference; not yet verified against a live tenant.

botId.description: Agent (bot) id. Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_AGENT_ID.

channel.description: Channel name; M365 is the only one the API supports today

clientId.description: Entra app (client) id for MSAL. Defaults to CPS_CLIENT_ID, then the first-party VS Code id.

environmentId.description: Power Platform environment id (GUID). Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_ENVIRONMENT_ID.

includeAgentSchema.description: Also put the agent schema in the package

outputPath.description: Where to write the zip. Default: beside the workspace, else the temp folder

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_download_channel_manifest
title: Download the Teams / Microsoft 365 app package
